description: A large silver swept-wing bomber with a tall vertical tail and paired engine pods under its wings sits on a wet, reflective tarmac under a dark stormy sky. Three or four people in uniform or overalls stand and kneel beside a small cart-like machine near the front wheels. A round star-and-bar roundel is on the fuselage. Distant aircraft and vehicles are faint in the background. The image is a painterly oil style, with no visible letters or numbers.
